cards.card_text: They'll remember how He was grieved by their adulterous hearts that turned away from Him, and by their eyes that lusted after idols.
cards.verse_text: Then in the nations to which they have been carried captive, your survivors will remember Me—how I have been grieved by their adulterous hearts that turned away from Me, and by their eyes that lusted after idols.

cards.card_text: 'How weak-willed is your heart,' God says, and He calls her an adulterous wife who takes in strangers instead of her own husband.
Jesus replies, "A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign…" Whew.
cards.verse_text: Jesus replied, “A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
